arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'scrapy/extensions/closespider.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('scrapy.extensions.closespider')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from unittest import mock
from scrapy.extensions.closespider import CloseSpider
ext = CloseSpider.__new__(CloseSpider)
ext.counter = {'itemcount': 0, 'pagecount_since_last_item': 0}
ext.close_on = {'itemcount': 2}
ext.crawler = mock.Mock()
ext.item_scraped(mock.Mock(), mock.Mock())
assert not ext.crawler.engine.close_spider.called, 'must not close before threshold'
ext.item_scraped(mock.Mock(), mock.Mock())
print('closed', ext.crawler.engine.close_spider.called)
assert ext.crawler.engine.close_spider.called, 'must close exactly at threshold'
print('itemcount_close_ok')

PYREPLAY
